title: Stargazer: DeFi Yield Optimizer for Cardano

ms.promise: (1) Integration of the liquidity pair (LP) tINDY/ADA and SundaeSwap as an integrated decentralized exchange (DEX) in which the money is invested.
ms.criteria: (1) The user can deposit the ADA into the Stargazer platform. After that, the ADA gets converted into LP. Then, the LP gets automatically invested into the SundaeSwap DEX.

ms.promise:
(1) Improve the user interface to have an additional risk assessment tool. This will assign each yield farming strategy a risk score helping the user to choose according to their personal needs.
(2) Integration of at least two more liquidity pairs to the platform, namely SBERRY/ADA, iUSD/ADA.
ms.criteria:
(1) In the user interface, each strategy has an assigned risk score (low, medium, or high risk) indicating the involved risk of it. This is clearly visible in the overview of all strategies and can help the user to make a decision. The risk score will be calculated by combining the popularity of the underlying tokens (market capitalization and monthly trading volume) and the Xerberus score of the team that created the tokens.
(2) The user can deposit two additional LPs into the Stargazer platform, namely SBERRY/ADA, iUSD/ADA. After that, the LPs get automatically put into the DEX.
ms.report:
A. Output: Improvement of the user interface to have an additional risk assessment tool. This will assign each yield farming strategy a risk score, helping the user to choose according to their personal needs.
Acceptance criteria: In the user interface, each strategy has an assigned risk score (low, medium, or high risk) indicating the involved risk of it. This is clearly visible in the overview of all strategies and can help the user to make a decision. The risk score will be calculated by combining the popularity of the underlying tokens (market capitalization and monthly trading volume) and the Xerberus score of the team that created the tokens.
Evidence:
・Video recording: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1eXS8wBXbtwBpJCxALI6Zy8dYQo3genGQ/view?usp=sharing: it shows the vaults overview page where each strategy displays a color-coded risk badge (green = low risk, yellow = medium risk, red = high risk) with a numeric score, the filter/sort functionality by risk level, and the breakdown modal showing how the 3-factor calculation (market cap, monthly trading volume, Xerberus rating) produces the final score.
・Risk methodology endpoint: https://api.stargazer.finance/risk/methodology returns the full scoring configuration, including market cap thresholds, volume thresholds, Xerberus rating mappings, and factor weights, allowing reviewers and users to verify how each risk score is calculated.

B. Output: Integration of at least two more liquidity pairs to the platform, namely SBERRY/ADA and iUSD/ADA.
